html:
Quest Giver: Tilles the Sellout

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 1 of Rotgut's Amazing Hotrod Key Relics from within the The Mutanous Malaise and return to Tilles the Sellout.

Quest Reward: 20 King's Coins

Return to: Tilles the Sellout

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Mutanous Malaise

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Collect 1 of Rotgut's Amazing Hotrod Key Relics from within the The Mutanous Malaise and return to Tilles the Sellout.

Offer:

Private Buyer Looking for an Amazing Relic!
WANTED: 1 of Rotgut's Amazing Hotrod Key Relics. Looking for a rocking relic to brag about to my group mates. Contact Tilles the Sellout for more info.

Turn-in:

You have a knack for finding these Relics. I'll contact the person who posted the ad on your behalf.

Objectives:

  • Rotgut's Amazing Relic ×1

Client level range: 30–55
